form:FormGroup.label: Max Total Rows
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of rows taken from a table for AI analysis. If the table has more, the data is truncated and the AI is told so. 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 10,000.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Rows Per Batch
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of table rows sent to the AI model in one prompt. Larger tables are split into batches whose answers are then merged. 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Rows per prompt, 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Parallel Batches
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of batches sent to the AI model at the same time. 1 to 100. Default is 4.

form:FormGroup.label: Attachment Download Timeout (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Time in milliseconds to wait for attached table data to finish downloading before asking the AI. Currently only the value saved with Set As Default is used. 1000 to 600,000. Default is 60,000 (1 minute).

form:FormGroup.label: Table Query System Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: Instructions sent to the AI model when answering questions about table data. A default prompt is provided.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Sent to the model with each table query.

form:FormGroup.label: Table Query User Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: Template for the message sent with each batch of table data. Use {{{{query}} for the user's question, {{{{table}} for the table data and {{{{context}} for earlier conversation.

form:FormGroup.label: Multi-Summary Merge Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: Template used to merge the answers from several batches into one. Use {{{{summaries}} for the numbered list of answers to merge.
